items.title_original: Menhan Dampingi Presiden Dalam Pertemuan Bilateral dengan Presiden Republik Arab Mesir
items.summary: Indonesia's Ministry of Defense reported on October 12 that Minister Sjafrie accompanied President Prabowo at the October 11 meeting with Egypt's president in Jakarta. It described discussions about deepening defense-industry cooperation, education, training and exchange of expertise; it did not document a separately signed defense-industry agreement or completed procurement.
caveats: The presidential meeting was on October 11; the Kemhan account was published October 12. Preserve the distinct event and publication dates.
The State Secretariat's four explicitly enumerated agreements concern foreign affairs, visas, statistics and marine/fisheries cooperation; none is a separately listed defense-industry MOU.
Defense-industry cooperation was discussed, not independently established as a signed defense procurement contract, delivered capability or implemented project.
